label: Chapter 6
english: There are eight principal kinds of tempting thoughts (logismoi), that contain within themselves every tempting thought: first, that of gluttony; and with it, that of sexual immorality; third, that of love of money; fourth, that of sadness; fifth, that of anger; sixth that of acedia; seventh, that of vainglory; eighth, that of pride.
We cannot control whether these tempting-thoughts can agitate the soul or not; but whether they remain in us or not, and whether they move the passions or not – that we can control.
